# Release Requirements Checklist: HeroVideo gouverné côté Odoo + bascule de la home

**Purpose**: Validate that release and closure requirements are complete, unambiguous, measurable, and internally consistent before merge
**Created**: 2026-08-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the exact gates included in “toutes les portes” enumerated consistently in the specification, plan, quickstart, and closure criteria? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK002 Does the specification define which release artifacts and receipts are mandatory versus optional or deferrable? [Gap, Spec §FR-008, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements documented for the interactive editor proof covering title, CTA, poster, persistence, duplication, reordering, and prohibited edits? [Completeness, Spec §SC-002, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK004 Are both visual-proof chains explicitly required for release, including their inputs, outputs, and archival locations? [Completeness, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK005 Does the release scope state whether the Step 0 source audit receipt alone is sufficient to close US3? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is “sous le seuil du projet” replaced or linked to the exact 2.0% Figma-parity threshold in the normative requirements? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK007 Is the reference viewport for the one-line title requirement specified with width, height, scale, browser, and font prerequisites? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK008 Is “toutes les portes restent vertes” clarified to distinguish feature-caused failures from accepted pre-existing failures? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK009 Is “zéro re-pin inexpliqué” defined with an explicit allowlist and required rationale format for every permitted re-pin? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK010 Is the meaning of “fidèle au master” expressed through objective visual and structural acceptance criteria rather than qualitative judgment alone? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Spec §SC-001]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Is the requirement that `evals/golden.json` remain unchanged reconciled with the closure note reporting a HeroVideo golden re-pin? [Conflict, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK012 Is the requirement that all gates pass reconciled with the closure note accepting `plugin:check`, derivation, build, and one eval failure as pre-existing? [Conflict, Spec §FR-008, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK013 Is the mandatory Figma visual-parity requirement reconciled with the decision to defer its subject, baseline, and execution? [Conflict, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK014 Is the required Odoo-to-emit-html visual proof reconciled with the closure note substituting a live home observation for the formal capture? [Conflict, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK015 Are the requirements consistent about editable parts when the spec limits them to title, CTA label, and poster but the quickstart also requires editable poster alt and CTA href? [Conflict, Spec §FR-004, Spec §SC-002]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Can release approval be determined objectively from a single documented rule when one or more repository gates are already red? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK017 Are the evidence requirements for “changes survive save and reopen” specific enough to establish what constitutes an acceptable receipt? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK018 Are the evidence requirements for autonomous duplication and reordering specific enough to distinguish inspection from demonstrated persistence? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK019 Is the allowed Odoo visual residual defined by a measurable ceiling in addition to the target of 0.0000% and the obligation to explain it? [Gap, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK020 Does each success criterion map to a named release receipt or an explicit, reviewed waiver? [Traceability, Spec §SC-001–SC-005]

## Scenario and Recovery Coverage

- [x] CHK021 Are release requirements defined for failure of the disposable Odoo environment after reference generation but before capture? [Gap, Recovery]
- [x] CHK022 Are requirements defined for a visual baseline or poster fixture that is missing, oversized, or intentionally not committed? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [x] CHK023 Does the spec define the required response when a gate fails for a demonstrably pre-existing reason: block, waive, isolate, or repair? [Gap, Recovery, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK024 Are rollback or restoration requirements documented if the reseeded snapshot cannot reconstruct the descriptor-and-addon pair? [Gap, Recovery, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK025 Are release requirements defined for a mismatch between the audited Figma master, historical node, and working instance references? [Gap, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-006]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK026 Is the assumption that a live Odoo observation can substitute for either formal visual-proof chain explicitly accepted by the release owner? [Assumption, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK027 Are external prerequisites for reproducible release proof documented, including Docker image, fonts, browser, Figma access, poster fixture, and disposable-instance identity? [Dependency, Gap]
- [x] CHK028 Is ownership assigned for the remaining interactive editor review, deferred visual subject, formal Odoo capture, and any waivers? [Gap, Spec §SC-001–SC-004]
- [x] CHK029 Is the prohibition on `piqueray-odoo-test:8071` stated as a release-blocking requirement across every procedure that starts or targets Odoo? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK030 Is the assumption that pre-existing branch defects are outside feature scope supported by dated baseline evidence and explicit reviewer acceptance criteria? [Assumption, Spec §SC-004]
